newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut Stock Exchange authorises two new brokers.
newsitem.headline: Beirut Stock Exchange authorises two new brokers.

text.p: The Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE) has authorised two new banks -- Mediterranee Investment Bank and Bank Saradar -- to operate as brokers from September 30, a stock exchange official said on Tuesday.
The two will raise to 10 the number of authorised brokers on the BSE.
September 30 is the day that shares of Lebanon's biggest company SOLIDERE are due to switch from the privately-operated Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) and start trading on the official exchange.
The SOLIDERE listing will add some $2 billion capitalisation to the BSE which currently lists the shares of four companies with a capitalisation totalling less than $400 million.
